description: This Java class models a 'resource' element in an entity configuration setup. It parses attributes 'loader' and 'location' from an XML element and provides accessors for these values, with validation to ensure they are present and non-empty.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: A thread-safe, final class that represents a resource configuration element with 'loader' and 'location' attributes, providing validation and access methods.

methods.name: Resource(Element)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a Resource object by parsing an XML Element, extracting 'loader' and 'location' attributes, with validation.

methods.name: getLoader
methods.description: Returns the value of the 'loader' attribute.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the value of the 'location' attribute.
